a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving, since we would need to get through two storm checks before taking anything. The reserve holds exactly 4 cells now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you see a better plan that doesn't leave us both likely dead, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
